title: PAR-07/S3.7 ACIS pointer range-before-narrowing guard
scope: Avoid narrowing an untrusted raw signed 64-bit graph pointer before range validation
Pin exact rooted-projection disposition for an out-of-range in-memory reference
Keep validation focused on the owning graph-preservation target

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-07/S3.7: compare raw pointer values to node-table bounds before converting to int
PAR-07/S3.7: retain raw token evidence and require exact InvalidReference disposition at rooted projection
assessment.planImpact: The graph builder now retains unresolved -1 for any pointer outside the node table and narrows only a nonnegative in-range value. The raw token remains available for the rooted validator, which fails closed with the precise InvalidReference node and pointer ordinal.

method.limitations: The regression uses an in-memory caller-built graph and does not establish a wire-level SAB producer case, ACIS semantics, or any DWG/DXF/native consumer support. No full suite or external reader was run.
